entities.name: Gurias of Tolaria
entities.description: Young wizard from the Smoke Mountains of Aerona who bullied villagers and attacked Greensleeves's Grove.

entities.name: Tobias
entities.description: Old wizard in the hills near the Smoke Mountains whose apprentice Gurias was.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Defender of villagers who subdued Gurias and later blasted him with Ball Lightning.

entities.name: Doris
entities.description: One of Greensleeves's bodyguards, killed by Gurias.

entities.name: Bywater
entities.description: Town near the village Gurias bullied.

entities.name: Greensleeves's Grove
entities.description: Grove attacked by wizards including Gurias.

events.summary: Gurias, bored with apprenticeship to Tobias, bullied villagers near Bywater for money, food and horses.
events.quote: began bullying the inhabitants of a village near the town of Bywater

events.summary: Greensleeves subdued Gurias, tagging him with the Stone Brain.
events.quote: she came to help the villagers and quickly subdued the inexperienced wizard

events.summary: Gurias killed Doris during the attack on Greensleeves's Grove.
Greensleeves blasted Gurias with Ball Lightning, leaving only his skull.
events.quote: Greensleeves lost her temper and blasted him with a Ball Lightning

relations.quote: Gurias was an apprentice of Tobias
